result.reason: Alert processing reads a Telegram chat identifier and links it with topic names, findings, URLs, and formatted messages for agent delivery. Documentation also explicitly describes using past conversations to contextualize alerts.

evidence.quote:
for alert in alerts:
        formatted.append({
            "id": alert.get("id"),
            "priority": alert.get("priority", "medium"),
            "channel": alert.get("channel", "telegram"),
            "target": os.environ.get("TOPIC_MONITOR_TELEGRAM_ID", ""),
            "topic_name": alert.get("topic_name"),
            "title": alert.get("title"),
            "url": alert.get("url"),
            "score": alert.get("score", 0),
            "message": format_alert_message(alert)
        })
- 🧩 **Memory Integration** - Contextual alerts referencing your past conversations
